note: Audited 2026-10-30 when the gate was added; on 2026-10-30 every editor control was routed through the registry. What remains needs a file picker, a drop, the export save panel or the app lifecycle. Remove an entry when its control routes through the registry.

methods.createProject: createProject(fromVideos:) needs dropped files; named creation goes through app.projects.create.
methods.export: Save panel or Poster hand-off; Chirpy runs editor.export, which calls the same session method.
methods.exportForPosting: Save panel or Poster hand-off; Chirpy runs editor.export, which calls the same session method.
methods.importAudio: Needs files the creator picks or drops; Chirpy can only open the picker (editor.media.import).
methods.importDropped: Needs files the creator picks or drops; Chirpy can only open the picker (editor.media.import).
methods.importMedia: Needs files the creator picks or drops; Chirpy can only open the picker (editor.media.import).
methods.openProject: Opens or writes a package the creator picks in a file panel; library projects open through app.projects.open.
methods.openStudioRecording: App hand-off: web Studio passes a recording by deep link and it is downloaded into a project, like opening a file. Not an edit.
methods.prepareForTermination: App lifecycle: flushes the pending edit on quit. Not a user action.
methods.retryManagedMedia: App lifecycle: retries copying imported files into the project package after a storage failure. Background file housekeeping, not an edit.
methods.saveCopy: Opens or writes a package the creator picks in a file panel; library projects open through app.projects.open.
